name: Barbell Side Bend
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold a light barbell securely across your upper back.
Brace your core and keep your chest facing straight ahead.
Bend smoothly sideways at your waist through a modest, controlled range without twisting your hips.
Contract your opposite oblique to stand upright, then bend to the other side, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Keep your chest facing straight forward so you bend purely sideways as the bar tilts.
Use a light barbell and small range to protect your lower spine.
